clue.text: Flat out, backing American deal

indicators.note: backing means the abbreviation for American is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: deal is timber of fir or pine, so it stands for pine

explanation.surface: Someone lies sprawled while supporting a transatlantic business deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying flat on one's back is the plain sense of the adjective; flat out describes such a posture.

clue.text: Deduces it is wrong to be led astray

indicators.note: wrong tells us the letters of the word Deduces are put in a wrong order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A detective concludes that it is a mistake to be misled.
explanation.definitionFit: To be led astray is to be tempted or lured into wrongdoing, a synonym for being enticed.

clue.text: Teardrops shed for hungry animals

indicators.note: shed suggests the letters of Teardrops are cast off and scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Tears are wept over starving beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunting animals that kill prey for food; a hungry animal stalking its meal is a natural example.

clue.text: Untidy heap of discarded clothing

indicators.note: a heap is a jumbled pile, so the letters of Untidy are piled up in a new order

explanation.surface: A messy pile of clothes has been thrown on the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: Nakedness is the state of having taken off one's garments, described cryptically as clothing cast aside.

clue.text: Alarming constituents in such an unsafe seat

indicators.note: the constituents of a word are its component letters, which here are rearranged from Alarming

explanation.surface: Worrying voters live in a parliamentary seat that could easily change hands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constituents' pretends to mean voters in a constituency; it is the anagram signal. A marginal seat in British elections is one won by a small majority.
explanation.definitionFit: In British politics a constituency held by a narrow majority is called a marginal, at risk of being lost.

clue.text: Israeli port area

definitions.meaning: A historic port city on the coast of northern Israel
a unit of land area, 4,840 square yards

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a coastal city in Israel; the other is the imperial measure of land surface.

clue.text: Denies a saying's wrong

indicators.note: wrong indicates the letters of a saying's are put in a wrong order

parts.note: the word saying's supplies its letters as written, including the final S

explanation.surface: Someone contradicts the claim that a proverb is mistaken.
explanation.definitionFit: To contradict or deny something is an old-fashioned synonym; the verb means to speak against.

clue.text: Inert form of chemical

indicators.note: form of signals a different shape or arrangement of the letters of Inert

explanation.surface: An unreactive version of some substance.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium nitrate, also called saltpetre, is a chemical compound used in gunpowder.

clue.text: Set of clothes awaiting a delivery date

definitions.text: Set of clothes awaiting a delivery date

parts.words: Set of clothes awaiting a delivery date
parts.note: a delivery date here is a baby's due date, so this is the set of garments prepared for a newborn

explanation.definitionFit: The word names the outfit and linen gathered in advance for a baby expected to be born.

clue.text: Fears the end of combined studies

indicators.note: the end of picks out only the last letter of the word combined

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it, so studies gives reads

explanation.surface: Worries that cross-disciplinary courses are being wound up.
explanation.definitionFit: To dread something is to fear it greatly, so the plural verb forms are synonyms.

clue.text: Flair shown when skill is added to effort

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of conversation
a try is an attempt or effort

explanation.surface: Talent appears when ability is combined with hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: Creative skill or talent in doing something, which is what flair also names.

clue.text: Water at the mouth

parts.note: suggests drooling, but means the tidal water where a river meets the sea at its mouth

explanation.definitionFit: A tidal inlet where a river's mouth widens into the sea, mixing fresh and salt water.

clue.text: It's backed in the race to beat one

indicators.note: in places the reversed letters inside the word for race

parts.note: a chase is a race in pursuit, or a steeplechase

indicators.note: backed means the letters of It's are written backwards

parts.note: the letters of It's taken as written, apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: Someone bets on a horse in a race hoping to beat a rival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backed' looks like betting on a horse in a race; it is the reversal signal. A steeplechase is often just called a chase in horse racing.
explanation.definitionFit: To punish severely, especially by beating, is an older sense of the verb meaning to rebuke harshly.

clue.text: Nod when told to go

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
someone sent away has been told to go

explanation.surface: A gesture given on being instructed to leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreement or approval, which a nod of the head signals.

clue.text: A nut-case?

parts.note: nut is slang for head, so the case holding the head's contents is the skull

explanation.definitionFit: The skull enclosing the brain; nut is slang for the head, so it is the head's protective casing.

clue.text: Desert? Not a lot of water

definitions.meaning: to desert or abandon someone, as in dropping a friend
a tiny amount of liquid, a single bead

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to abandon; the other is a very small quantity of liquid.

clue.text: After the game, Scrabble piece may be found on the floor

definitions.text: may be found on the floor

indicators.note: After places the Scrabble piece behind the game in the answer

parts.note: quarry is hunted game, the prey pursued
the lettered pieces in the board game Scrabble are called tiles

explanation.surface: Once a match is over, a stray letter tile can be found dropped on the floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game' suggests a board game, but here it is hunted prey.
explanation.definitionFit: Unglazed hard-fired clay squares used to cover floors, so they are found underfoot.

clue.text: Forced into service — and unlikely to forget it

definitions.meaning: press gangs once seized men for naval service
someone deeply struck by an experience will remember it

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is conscripted by a press gang; the other is strongly struck and admiring.

clue.text: Caledonian will be put out by this cost

indicators.note: put out suggests the letters of this cost are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A Scot will be annoyed by this expense.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface plays on the joke of Scottish thrift; 'put out' means annoyed but signals the rearrangement. Caledonia is the Latin name for Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Caledonia is the old Roman name for Scotland, so the adjective means of Scotland.

clue.text: Too old for love, but no longer minding

definitions.meaning: read as beyond the age of romance, caring meaning loving
indifferent, having stopped worrying about something

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means having stopped worrying; read literally it is beyond the age of affection.

clue.text: Poor people take exams outside university

indicators.note: outside puts the word for exams around the abbreviation for university

parts.note: exam papers are the papers sat in an examination

explanation.surface: Students from poor homes sit exams away from campus.
explanation.definitionFit: Destitute people with no means of support, the poor in an older word.

clue.text: Yet such a championship may be close

definitions.text: Yet such a championship may be close

parts.words: Yet such a championship may be close
parts.note: an ... golf or tennis tournament is ..., the opposite of close, yet its result may be close

explanation.definitionFit: Tournaments open to amateurs and professionals alike are called Opens, such as golf's British Open.

clue.text: Little Margaret's after fruit and spices

indicators.note: after places Margaret's pet name behind the fruit

parts.note: a nut is botanically a kind of fruit
Meg is a short form of the name Margaret, here with its possessive S

explanation.surface: A young girl's spice rack sits next to the fruit bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: Aromatic seeds of a tropical tree, grated as a kitchen seasoning.

clue.text: They support parades with conscious pride

definitions.meaning: braces or bars that hold up a structure
walks with a swaggering, self-important gait

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is supporting bars; the other is swaggering about showily.

clue.text: Hassles with top dentures?

definitions.meaning: read as ..., the upper sets of false teeth

explanation.definitionFit: Troubles or disturbances; read as two words, upper sets of false teeth.

clue.text: Clean up in the lottery

definitions.meaning: a sweepstake, where entrants draw names such as horses in a race

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is brushing a floor clean; the other is a sweepstake gamble.

clue.text: Result of division not quite correct

indicators.note: correct means the letters of not quite are put right by rearranging them

explanation.surface: A sum that has come out slightly wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not quite correct' reads as a single phrase meaning slightly wrong, but 'correct' is the anagram signal acting on NOT QUITE.
explanation.definitionFit: In arithmetic, dividing one number by another gives this figure.

clue.text: Fish for tea

definitions.meaning: a fish of the trout family
cha or ... is British slang for tea

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a trout-like fish; the other is old British slang for a cup of tea.

clue.text: Faculty I mention in speech

indicators.note: in speech means the words are to be heard spoken, not read

parts.note: to cite is to mention, so I mention gives I cite

explanation.surface: A college department is something I bring up while talking.
explanation.definitionFit: Vision is one of the bodily senses, and a sense or ability is called a faculty.

clue.text: Seek to obtain funds for university admittance

indicators.note: admittance means the abbreviation for university is admitted inside the word for funds

parts.note: a purse is a sum of money or available funds

explanation.surface: Someone seeks money to pay for a place at college.
explanation.definitionFit: To follow or strive for something, such as pursuing a goal, is to seek to obtain it.

clue.text: Perhaps one is turned to stone

definitions.text: Perhaps one is turned to stone

parts.words: Perhaps one is turned to stone
parts.note: suggests petrification as in myth, but a gem is cut and polished, i.e. turned, as a precious stone

explanation.definitionFit: A precious blue gemstone, one example of a stone cut for jewellery.

clue.text: Remarks we're not supposed to hear when the team comes in

definitions.text: Remarks we're not supposed to hear

indicators.note: comes in places the word for team inside the word for when

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he spoke'
a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: Things said under the breath as the players walk on.
explanation.definitionFit: In theatre, lines spoken to the audience that other characters supposedly do not hear.
